01 / About

A clinic that begins with its name

Artisan Clinic is a modern plastic surgery and aesthetic medicine clinic in Warsaw. Our name is no accident — it reflects our sense of aesthetics, harmony, beauty, precision and respect for the patient’s health.

artart + sanatiohealing

We perform highly specialised plastic surgery as well as surgical oncology procedures — including breast reconstruction. We also offer minimally invasive aesthetic medicine: fillers, botox, biostimulators, laser therapy and body contouring.

02 / Treatments

Four areas of practice

Below are selected procedures with indicative price ranges. The final quote is set during the consultation — after qualification and choosing the technique for your individual needs.

Restore proportion, not change the face

A wide range of plastic surgery and aesthetic medicine procedures that restore a younger look, improve facial proportions and enhance natural beauty.

  • Face lift (facelift)
  • Rhinoplasty
  • Eyelid, ear and chin surgery
  • Aptos thread face lift
  • Lipofilling with stem cells

The body — contouring and treatment

  • Arm lift
  • Liposuction
  • Phlebology — vein treatment

  • Breast reduction

03 / Team

The people who operate

Plastic surgeons, oncological surgeons, aesthetic medicine specialists and cosmetologists — 11 specialists who guide each patient from consultation to recovery.

Tadeusz Witwicki, MD, PhD

Plastic, reconstructive and aesthetic surgery

He studied at the Medical Academy in Warsaw and trained in Beijing, Glasgow, Los Angeles and Ghent. He completed his specialisation at the Department of Plastic Surgery of the Medical Centre for Postgraduate Education in Warsaw under the founder of Polish plastic surgery, Prof. Michał Krauss. Founding member of the Polish Society of Aesthetic and Anti-Aging Medicine, international APTOS trainer and author of numerous publications.

He has run his own medical practice for more than twenty years.

04 / Process

From conversation to result

Consultations take place at ul. Francuska 42, procedures — at the clinic at ul. Nasturcjowa 6.

01

Consultation

A conversation and examination. We discuss expectations, indications and what the method can realistically achieve.

02

Treatment plan

04

Aftercare
